newsitem.title: UK: Rain forecast for France, England on Sunday - WSC.
newsitem.headline: Rain forecast for France, England on Sunday - WSC.

text.p: England and France can expect Thursday's warm, dry weather to continue into the weekend but rain is forecast for Sunday, independent U.S. forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Thursday.

A very weak front could bring "a few, very light showers, if any" for England and western France on Saturday, but cloud cover was forecast to increase that night and bring rain on Sunday, WSC forecaster Joel Burgio told Reuters by telephone from Lexington, Mass.
"Early Sunday through to Monday showers and rain will expand to cover the entire region, all of England and most of France," Burgio said.
Rain amounts of 8-25 mm, locally heavier, were expected with good coverage.
Temperatures would be cooler through to Tuesday, with a daytime high in the low- to mid-50s F and a nighttime high of the upper 30s to lower 40s.
Much of northwestern Europe has been hit by a three-month drought.
